newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-SPAIN'S RAUL HOPES TO REPEAT PRAGUE PERFORMANCE IN DEBUT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SPAIN'S RAUL HOPES TO REPEAT PRAGUE PERFORMANCE IN DEBUT.

text.p: Teenager Raul Gonzalez looks set to make his full international debut for Spain on Wednesday in the World Cup qualifier against the Czech Republic in Prague, the city where he played his best game for the country at junior level.
Coach Javier Clemente is playing his cards close to his chest, but the Spanish press has taken it for granted that Raul will at least come on as substitute.
Raul, 19, led his side to victory aginst the Czechs with two goals in the quarter-final of last-season's European under-21 competition, guaranteeing Spain a place in the Olympics.

Despite a poor showing in Atlanta, Raul has gone from strength to strength at club level, where he leads the Real Madrid goalscoring tables even after being moved back to midfield by new coach Fabio Capello.

Squad newcomers Ismael Urzaiz, who on Monday turned 25, and Roberto Rios who will also be 25 on Wednesday, will be lucky to find the notoriously dour Clemente in charitable mood, and are unlikely to celebrate a first cap.
Atletico Madrid playmaker Jose Luis Caminero and Barcelona striker Juan Pizzi are both recovering from injuries and are unlikely to start the game.
